name: SecOps-NG: EU AI Act Article 26 deployer obligations with Article 27 fundamental-rights impact assessment

nodes.name: eu_ai_act_deployer_obligations_start

values.name: __deployment_id__
values.description: Stable operator-side identifier of the high-risk AI system deployment this cycle covers. Joins the intended-use determination, the oversight assignment, the monitoring record, the fundamental-rights assessment and the retention record on one key.

values.name: __system_reference__
values.description: Reference to the provider's high-risk AI system and the instructions for use accompanying it (Art. 13). External — supplied from the operator's deployment register.

values.name: __deployment_record__
values.description: The deployment-register entry for __deployment_id__: exactly deployment_id, system_reference, declared_contexts (a non-empty list of context tags), workplace and deployer_is_employer (real booleans).

values.name: __instructions_for_use__
values.description: The provider's instructions for use for __system_reference__: exactly system_reference, intended_purpose and permitted_contexts (a non-empty list of context tags).

values.name: __workforce_notice__
values.description: The Art. 26(7) notice record: exactly notified_at (Zulu), workers_representatives_informed and affected_workers_informed (real booleans). Empty when there is none (the n8n trigger supplies an empty string for an unset variable).

values.name: __determined_at__
values.description: Zulu instant (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) of the intended-use determination.

values.name: __system_profile__
values.description: Exactly high_risk_basis (art_6_1 or art_6_2) and annex_iii_point (the Annex III point, or null for an Art. 6(1) system); decides the Art. 27(1) scope.

values.name: __deployer_profile__
values.description: Exactly public_law_body and private_public_service_provider (real booleans); decides the Art. 27(1) scope.

values.name: __fria_assessment__
values.description: The deployer's own assessment: element letter (a to f) to text, for the Art. 27(1) elements it assesses itself. Empty out of scope.

values.name: __dpia_record__
values.description: The GDPR Art. 35 DPIA the assessment complements (Art. 27(4)): exactly dpia_ref and covered_elements. Empty when there is none (the n8n trigger supplies an empty string for an unset variable).

values.name: __art_46_1_exemption__
values.description: Whether the Art. 46(1) derogation exempts the Art. 27(3) notification. A real boolean.

values.name: __fria_template_ref__
values.description: Reference of the AI Office's Art. 27(5) template the notification uses. Empty when there is none (the n8n trigger supplies an empty string for an unset variable).

values.name: __assessed_at__
values.description: Zulu instant (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) of the fundamental-rights assessment.

values.name: __oversight_assignees__
values.description: The Art. 26(2) assignees, each exactly person_ref, natural_person (a real boolean) and one evidence reference per limb: competence_ref, training_ref, authority_ref, support_ref. CACAO v2 has no list type, so the value rides as a string carrying a JSON-native list; the compile target's adapter seam marshals it.

values.name: __assigned_at__
values.description: Zulu instant (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) of the oversight assignment.

values.name: __monitoring_window__
values.description: Exactly window_start and window_end (Zulu).

values.name: __input_data__
values.description: Exactly deployer_controls_input_data (a real boolean) and relevant and sufficiently_representative (real booleans where the deployer controls the input data, null where it does not).

values.name: __monitoring_findings__
values.description: The window's findings, each exactly finding_ref, kind (routine, art_79_risk or serious_incident) and determined_at, plus suspended_at for a risk and aware_at, outcomes, widespread_infringement and provider_reachable for a serious incident. CACAO v2 has no list type, so the value rides as a string carrying a JSON-native list; the compile target's adapter seam marshals it.

values.name: __evaluated_at__
values.description: Zulu instant (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) the window is evaluated at; the Art. 73 margin runs from it.

values.name: __log_retention__
values.description: Exactly logs_under_deployer_control (a real boolean), retention_months (a positive integer, or null when the logs are not under the deployer's control) and legal_basis_ref (the law that sets a different period, or null).

values.name: __workflow_id__
values.description: Identifier of the workflow, folded into the evidence artifact_id.

values.name: __execution_id__
values.description: Identifier of this execution, folded into the evidence artifact_id.

values.name: __captured_at__
values.description: Zulu instant (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) the evidence is captured at, folded into its artifact_id.

values.name: __intended_use_determination_id__
values.description: Identifier of the dated Art. 26(1) determination, including the negative case. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __intended_use_determination__.determination_id.

values.name: __oversight_assignment_id__
values.description: Identifier of the Art. 26(2) oversight assignment. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __oversight_assignment__.assignment_id.

values.name: __monitoring_observation_id__
values.description: Identifier of the per-window Art. 26(5) observation, carrying the Art. 26(4) input-data determination. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __monitoring_observation__.observation_id.

values.name: __escalation_trigger_class__
values.description: Which Art. 26(5) trigger the window resolved to: routine, art_79_risk or serious_incident. Kept separate from the observation identifier because the three carry different legal consequences. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __monitoring_observation__.escalation_trigger_class.

values.name: __fria_determination_id__
values.description: Identifier of the Art. 27 record, which holds the in-scope determination in every case. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __fria_record__.fria_id.

values.name: __retention_evidence_id__
values.description: Identifier of the dated cycle-evidence artifact. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __retention_evidence__.artifact_id.

values.name: __intended_use_determination__
values.description: Envelope the confirm-intended-use step emits: the declared and exceeded contexts, the Art. 26(7) notice outcome, proceed as a real boolean, and the blocking reasons.

values.name: __deployment_may_proceed__
values.description: Whether the deployment may proceed; false ends the cycle with the negative determination on record. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __intended_use_determination__.proceed. A real boolean: the gate compares it to true.

values.name: __fria_record__
values.description: Envelope the fundamental-rights step emits: the Art. 27(1) scope and its basis, the six elements and their source, the notification status, and blocks_deployment.

values.name: __fria_blocks_deployment__
values.description: Whether an in-scope assessment is incomplete, which Art. 27(1) makes a bar to deploying; true ends the cycle. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __fria_record__.blocks_deployment. A real boolean.

values.name: __oversight_assignment__
values.description: Envelope the oversight step emits: each assignee against the four Art. 26(2) limbs, the uncovered assignees, and whether the assignment is complete.

values.name: __monitoring_observation__
values.description: Envelope the monitoring step emits: the input-data determination, the findings, the escalation class, the duties each finding triggers, and the outstanding suspensions.

values.name: __retention_evidence__
values.description: Envelope the retention step emits: the four joined records and the Art. 26(6) retention disposition.

nodes.notes: Entry point. Fires on the operator's pre-deployment gate for a high-risk AI system, and on each subsequent monitoring cycle for a system already in service.

nodes.name: confirm_intended_use

parameters.pythonCode:
from content.playbooks.eu_ai_act_deployer_obligations.primitives.intended_use import determine_intended_use
__intended_use_determination__ = determine_intended_use(deployment=__deployment_record__, instructions=__instructions_for_use__, workforce_notice=__workforce_notice__, determined_at=__determined_at__)

nodes.notes: Reconcile the deployment's declared contexts against the contexts the provider's instructions for use permit, per Art. 26(1), and record the determination against __deployment_id__. Where the deployer is an employer deploying at the workplace, the Art. 26(7) notice to workers' representatives and affected workers is a precondition, dated before the determination, because a deployment that proceeds without it cannot be remediated after the fact. The negative case is a first-class outcome: proceed is false, the blocking reasons are named, and the gate that follows ends the cycle, so no downstream step fires. Produces __intended_use_determination__, from which __intended_use_determination_id__ and __deployment_may_proceed__ are extracted.

nodes.name: deployment may proceed?
nodes.notes: Branch on __deployment_may_proceed__, extracted from the intended-use determination. True goes on to the fundamental-rights assessment; false ends the cycle, so a deployment outside the intended purpose or without its Art. 26(7) notice never reaches oversight, monitoring or evidence.

nodes.name: assess_fundamental_rights_impact

parameters.pythonCode:
from content.playbooks.eu_ai_act_deployer_obligations.primitives.fria import assess_fundamental_rights_impact
__fria_record__ = assess_fundamental_rights_impact(intended_use=__intended_use_determination__, system_profile=__system_profile__, deployer_profile=__deployer_profile__, assessment=__fria_assessment__, dpia=__dpia_record__, art_46_1_exemption=__art_46_1_exemption__, notification_template_ref=__fria_template_ref__, assessed_at=__assessed_at__)

nodes.notes: Perform the Art. 27 fundamental-rights impact assessment before deploying, and record it against __deployment_id__. The first output is the scope determination: Annex III systems other than point 2, for bodies governed by public law and private entities providing public services, and every deployer of a point 5(b) or 5(c) system; out of scope the step closes with a dated record. In scope, the six Art. 27(1)(a)-(f) elements are a checklist, and per Art. 27(4) an element an existing GDPR Art. 35 DPIA already satisfies is recorded as such and not reassessed. The notification of the results to the market-surveillance authority (Art. 27(3)) uses the AI Office's Art. 27(5) template where the operator holds one, and is otherwise recorded as due rather than bound to a guessed shape. An incomplete in-scope assessment blocks deployment, and the gate that follows ends the cycle. Produces __fria_record__, from which __fria_determination_id__ and __fria_blocks_deployment__ are extracted.

nodes.name: assessment blocks deployment?
nodes.notes: Branch on __fria_blocks_deployment__, extracted from the fundamental-rights record. True ends the cycle, because Art. 27(1) requires the assessment before deploying and an in-scope assessment is incomplete; false goes on to the oversight assignment.

nodes.name: assign_human_oversight
nodes.notes: Assign human oversight of the deployment to natural persons per Art. 26(2), and record the assignment against __deployment_id__. The obligation has four independently checkable limbs and the record names each assignee against each: competence, training, authority, and the necessary support; an assignee missing any limb, or not a natural person, is uncovered and leaves the assignment incomplete. The capability set an overseer must be able to exercise is fixed by Art. 14(4) and evidenced by the ai_human_oversight playbook. Produces __oversight_assignment__, from which __oversight_assignment_id__ is extracted.

nodes.name: monitor_operation

parameters.pythonCode:
from content.playbooks.eu_ai_act_deployer_obligations.primitives.monitoring import classify_monitoring_window
__monitoring_observation__ = classify_monitoring_window(intended_use=__intended_use_determination__, oversight=__oversight_assignment__, window=__monitoring_window__, input_data=__input_data__, findings=__monitoring_findings__, evaluated_at=__evaluated_at__)

nodes.notes: Monitor operation on the basis of the instructions for use per Art. 26(5), and record the window against __deployment_id__, with the Art. 26(4) determination that input data the deployer controls is relevant and sufficiently representative, or the dated determination of non-control. The three escalation triggers are kept apart: routine findings feed the provider's Art. 72 loop; an Art. 79(1) risk obliges informing the provider or distributor and the market-surveillance authority and suspending use, without undue delay; and a serious incident obliges immediate sequenced notification, provider first, on the severity-classed Art. 73 clock, with the deployer reporting itself if the provider cannot be reached. Produces __monitoring_observation__, from which __monitoring_observation_id__ and __escalation_trigger_class__ are extracted.

nodes.name: retain_logs_and_evidence

parameters.pythonCode:
from content.playbooks.eu_ai_act_deployer_obligations.primitives.retention import compose_retention_evidence
__retention_evidence__ = compose_retention_evidence(intended_use=__intended_use_determination__, oversight=__oversight_assignment__, observation=__monitoring_observation__, fria=__fria_record__, log_retention=__log_retention__, workflow_id=__workflow_id__, execution_id=__execution_id__, captured_at=__captured_at__)

nodes.notes: Record the retention disposition for the logs the system generates automatically, per Art. 26(6), and emit the dated cycle-evidence artifact joining the intended-use determination, the fundamental-rights record, the oversight assignment and the monitoring observation against __deployment_id__. The obligation binds only to logs under the deployer's control; for those the period is appropriate to the intended purpose and at least six months, unless applicable Union or national law provides otherwise, in either direction, which the record cites. The log store is an operator-owned surface. Produces __retention_evidence__, from which __retention_evidence_id__ is extracted.

nodes.name: eu_ai_act_deployer_obligations_end
nodes.notes: Terminal state. The cycle closes on the dated evidence artifact; the next monitoring window re-enters at the start step.

## EU AI Act Article 26 deployer obligations with Article 27 fundamental-rights impact assessment
`playbook.eu_ai_act_deployer_obligations@v1` · content v1.0.0 · maturity: stable · compiled from a CACAO 2.0 playbook by SecOps-NG

CACAO v2 playbook for the operator-side EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) Article 26 deployer-obligation lifecycle, gated by the Article 27 fundamental-rights impact assessment. Every other EU AI Act surface in this catalogue anchors on the provider — Art. 9 risk management, Art. 11 technical documentation, Art. 13 transparency, Art. 15 robustness, Art. 72 post-market monitoring, Art. 73 serious-incident reporting. This playbook is the first on the deployer side: the ope…

**Controls:** 3 control reference(s) in the canonical source, mapped under `content/mappings/`.

**Before you run it**
- Inputs the trigger expects from you: `__deployment_id__`, `__system_reference__`, `__deployment_record__`, `__instructions_for_use__`, `__workforce_notice__`, `__determined_at__`, `__system_profile__`, `__deployer_profile__`, `__fria_assessment__`, `__dpia_record__`, `__art_46_1_exemption__`, `__fria_template_ref__`, `__assessed_at__`, `__oversight_assignees__`, `__assigned_at__`, `__monitoring_window__`, `__input_data__`, `__monitoring_findings__`, `__evaluated_at__`, `__log_retention__`, `__workflow_id__`, `__execution_id__`, `__captured_at__`
- Code nodes name the deterministic primitive each step runs; bind them to where your primitives execute, or replace the body:
  - confirm_intended_use → `content.playbooks.eu_ai_act_deployer_obligations.primitives.intended_use.determine_intended_use`
  - assess_fundamental_rights_impact → `content.playbooks.eu_ai_act_deployer_obligations.primitives.fria.assess_fundamental_rights_impact`
  - assign_human_oversight → `content.playbooks.eu_ai_act_deployer_obligations.primitives.oversight.compose_oversight_assignment`
  - monitor_operation → `content.playbooks.eu_ai_act_deployer_obligations.primitives.monitoring.classify_monitoring_window`
  - retain_logs_and_evidence → `content.playbooks.eu_ai_act_deployer_obligations.primitives.retention.compose_retention_evidence`
